xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: (1) Please note pursuant to the NCLT Order dated 25th November, 2024, Macrofil Investments Limited (Macrofil) has been amalgamated with Nowrosjee Wadia & Sons Limited (NWS) as per the Scheme of Amalgamation between Macrofil and NWS. Both the Companies belong to the Promoter Group of the Company and procedural formalities are underway. (2) Pursuant to the Point no. 37 of the FAQs of NSE dated 9th July, 2025, the name of Naperol Investments Limited (CIN: U65990MH1980PLC022589) has been removed from the category of Promoter Group in the shareholding pattern of the Company in view of the implementation of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement among National Peroxide Limited, Naperol Investments Limited, and NPL Chemicals Limited under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. As per the Order dated May 4, 2023, passed by the Honble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), the original Naperol Investments Limited has been amalgamated into National Peroxide Limited and thus ceased to exist. Further please note that, National Peroxide Limited has been renamed as Naperol Investments Limited. Accordingly, Naperol Investments Limited (formerly National Peroxide Limited) (CIN: L66309MH1954PLC009254) now holds 18,95,900 equity shares of the Company. 3) Under orders from the Special Court (Trial of Offences relating to Transactions in Securities) Act, 1992, the allotment of 4,640 equity shares of face value of Rs 2/- each against warrants carrying rights of conversion into equity shares of the Company has been kept in abeyance in accordance with Section 206A of the Companies Act, 1956, till such time as the title of the bonafide owner is certified by the concerned Stock Exchanges.
